SELECT * FROM ( SELECT TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, JNL_DATE, JNL_TIME, CASSETTE_TYPE, CASSETTE_NO, CURRENCY, DENOMINATION, REMAIN_QTY, (DENOMINATION * REMAIN_QTY) AS AMOUNT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CASSETTE_TYPE, CASSETTE_NO ORDER BY JNL_DATE DESC, JNL_TIME DESC ) AS RN FROM T_ADD_CASH
) SNAP WHERE SNAP.RN = 1 ORDER BY TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CASSETTE_TYPE, CASSETTE_NO OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY TERM_GROUP_ID, TERM_ID, CASSETTE_TYPE, CASSETTE_NO ORDER BY JNL_DATE DESC, JNL_TIME DESC ) AS RN FROM T_ADD_CASH
) SNAP WHERE SNAP.RN = 1
